name: Workspace
description: First-party design system for the Workspace product surface: frosted glass over a persona bloom, a fixed four-colour actor grammar (you / agent / gate / system), four honest state faces, cited why-panels, three undo outcomes and a 12px floor. Greenhouse is the default persona; slate and studio ship as templates; users may author their own from four values.
